title: Send to rekordbox
warning: Don't play or edit in rekordbox between writing the file and finishing the import (changes made in between are lost)

export.title: Export your collection from rekordbox
export.howTo: In rekordbox, choose File > Export Collection in xml format. Then read the export here.

review.title: Review what will be sent

leftOutReason.pathNotSendable: path can't be sent to rekordbox
leftOutReason.unsendableCharacter: {{attribute}} has a character rekordbox XML can't hold
leftOutReason.rekordboxEntry: rekordbox's entry can't be sent back

review.fileMissing_one: {{count, number}} track is sent with its file missing (rekordbox keeps its entry)
review.fileMissing_other: {{count, number}} tracks are sent with their files missing (rekordbox keeps their entries)
review.otherFile_one: rekordbox already has another file of {{count, number}} track (sending adds a second entry)
review.otherFile_other: rekordbox already has another file of {{count, number}} tracks (sending adds a second entry for each)
review.losesEntries: Crates that arrive with tracks left out (rekordbox replaces its playlist of the same name)
review.losesEntriesRow_one: {{name}} ({{count, number}} of {{entries, number}} track left out)
review.losesEntriesRow_other: {{name}} ({{count, number}} of {{entries, number}} tracks left out)
review.notStored_one: {{count, number}} track in the export couldn't be read. If it's in your Library it's sent as new, and a Yes in rekordbox overwrites rekordbox's entry.
review.notStored_other: {{count, number}} tracks in the export couldn't be read. Any that are in your Library are sent as new, and a Yes in rekordbox overwrites rekordbox's entry.

refused.incompleteExport: Can't send: the export is incomplete. Export the collection again from rekordbox.
refused.sameName: Can't send: two crates in one folder share a name ({{path}})
refused.noName: Can't send: a crate has no name ({{path}})
refused.unsendableName: Can't send: a name has a character rekordbox XML can't hold ({{path}})
refused.tooDeep: Can't send: folders are nested too deep ({{path}})
refused.internal: Can't send: the file couldn't be made. Try again or restart the app.

write.title: Write the file
write.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the path and copy it.

failure.noPreflight: Read the export again before sending
failure.exportChanged: The export changed after it was read. Read it again.
failure.libraryChanged: Your Library changed after the review. Read the export again.
failure.cantWrite: Can't write the file (the last file is unchanged). Try again.
failure.cantRecord: Can't save the send. Don't import the file. Try again.
failure.internal: Something went wrong. Try again or restart the app.

import.title: Import in rekordbox
import.show: First time only: in Preferences > View > Layout, tick rekordbox xml
import.point: First time only: in Preferences > Advanced > Database > rekordbox xml > Imported Library, choose Browse and paste the path
import.refresh: In the sidebar, open rekordbox xml and click its refresh icon
import.tracks: Open All Tracks, select every track, right-click and choose Import to Collection
import.dialogsUnknown: rekordbox asks Yes or No for each track it already has. Answer Yes.
import.dialogs_one: Expect {{count, number}} Yes/No dialog (for the track rekordbox already has). Answer Yes.
import.dialogs_other: Expect {{count, number}} Yes/No dialogs (one for each track rekordbox already has). Answer Yes.
import.playlists: Under Playlists, right-click Crates and choose Import Playlist. If rekordbox asks to replace playlists with the same name, click OK.
